items.overview: Winter in Ehrenfest is heavy following Ferdinand’s departure. The purge has been moved forward after a tip-off regarding Georgine, who thrives on turmoil like the 'Goddess of Chaos.' Meanwhile, Rozemyne, now a third-year at the Royal Academy, keeps herself busy to shake off the lingering sense of loss. Within the dormitory, she works to persuade the children of the former Veronica faction to avoid being implicated in the purge; within the Academy, the first day of Archduke Candidate classes begins. From the Scholar course exams to meeting a new Head Librarian and choosing a specialized major, she plunges into a daily life where her position and environment have drastically changed from a year ago. As she gradually regains her usual spirit and receives an overwhelming amount of divine protection from the gods, Rozemyne’s rampaging progress shows no signs of stopping! 'Let my Bookworm Virus spread to everyone!' The comicalization of the series' final chapter, 'Part 5,' begins! Heading toward the very foundation of Yurgenschmidt — the legend of the Saint takes flight!"

My Older Sister's Friend Is Annoying
Bạn thân của chị gái tôi thật phiền phức
items.overview:
High school freshman Nao Misumi has known Sena Ikuta, his older sister Rio’s best friend, since he was in elementary school. As a self-proclaimed “sister’s boy”, Nao has always found Sena’s over-familiarity incredibly annoying. Yet, despite being loud, airheaded, and having zero sense of personal space, he could never truly bring himself to hate her. She has always looked out for him just as much as she has for Rio. 

She’s a total idiot, too carefree, and her sense of personal space is completely broken. To Nao, she’s supposed to be nothing more than a nuisance, and yet... 

“At first, I hated her for sure. She was noisy, and always took the things I cherished. So why is it that now—?” 

Even as he grumbles about her constantly calling him “Lil bro," he finds himself unable to leave her alone. How did this “annoying” fixture in his life become the one person he can’t look away from?

items.overview: Modern Japan - One night when a meteor shower fell, dungeons infested with strange monsters appeared all over the world. People all over the world were now able to check their own "status". The days of peace have come to an end, and it has become people's duty to go into dungeons and hunt monsters. All humans are ranked according to their status, and the main character, Takashi Nakamura, who only has the lowest-ranked abilities, is ridiculed, but spends his hard days hiding in dungeons as a burden carrier for the strong. However, Takashi's fate begins to change when he encounters the B-rank monster Argos in the dungeon. Takashi can now freely teleport to a game-like fantasy [different world], and his experience points there can now be reflected in his current status.
